_note: Milestones for /timeline/. Series, yearly story counts and photos are added automatically; add life and work milestones here. date is YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD; url is optional (a post, page or Substack link). skip_photos: any photo whose address contains one of these words is left off the timeline, photo wall and series pages.

milestones.title: The first post
milestones.text: Travel expenses from a trip to Spain and Morocco: the blog begins.

milestones.title: Two decisions
milestones.text: An internship at Amnesty International and a place at Sanford housing cooperative set the course for the decade: writing, volunteering and travel.

milestones.title: No more aeroplanes
milestones.text: Gave up flying for slow travel, “for the simple reason that air travel stunts my imagination”.

milestones.title: The Soles of My Shoes is published
milestones.text: A hitch-hiking tale of London to Ben Nevis, released as a paperback, an ebook and 152 blog episodes: Slow Publishing.

milestones.title: The newsletter begins
milestones.text: The first monthly email newsletter goes out. It goes weekly in 2017 and is still going every Friday.

milestones.title: Elevate #10
milestones.text: A book of creative responses to a world in crisis, pay what you want.

milestones.title: Foiled at the Edinburgh Fringe
milestones.text: The hair salon sitcom, co-written with Beth Granville, gets a five-star run at the Fringe.

milestones.title: Joining Thighs of Steel
milestones.text: First ride with Thighs of Steel, Ljubljana to Sofia: “I had found my community.”

milestones.title: Foiled on BBC Radio Wales
milestones.text: Three radio series from 2017 to 2019, with guest stars including Miles Jupp, Ralf Little and Sir Derek Jacobi.

milestones.title: A Celtic Media Award nomination
milestones.text: The second radio series of Foiled is nominated.

milestones.title: A new Davecade
milestones.text: Looking back on the 2010s and forward to the twenties.

milestones.title: 100 Days of Adventure
milestones.text: After 2,117 hours at the computer in 2020, a year counting days spent outdoors on adventures.

milestones.title: Goodbye, Thighs of Steel
milestones.text: Thighs of Steel, the refugee solidarity bike ride, closes. Together the riders raised over £760,000 for projects run by refugees for refugees.

milestones.title: This archive
milestones.text: The blog moves off WordPress to become this free, permanent archive of twenty years of stories.
